description: This Swift source file defines the GatewayNodeSession actor responsible for managing WebSocket-based communication with a gateway server, including connection management, invoking commands with timeout handling, processing incoming messages and events, managing session state, and handling URL normalization and capability refreshes.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSession
classes.description: An actor that manages session state for gateway communication, including connection lifecycle, event handling, and request invocation with timeout.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeout
methods.description: Executes a request with a specified timeout, returning a response, using async/await and concurrent tasks.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the gateway server via a WebSocket, setting session callbacks and managing connection state.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates the current connection and resets session state.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests and updates the canvas capability URL for the node, parsing server response and updating internal state.
